_README: Ground-truth form labels for the numeric-bar validation (next session). Fill in the timestamp (in SECONDS from the clip start) of each swing event you can see in that clip, plus the step count. Leave a value null if the event isn't visible in that view. Rear clips (8846-48) see steps / shoulders / off-arm / backswing height + finish; side clips (8824-26) see spine tilt / release / slide. Label only what's clearly visible — a null is better than a guess. Copy this file to form_labels.json and fill it. Tolerance target: timing events within ~0.08 s (about 2 frames at 30 fps); step_count exact.

_events.E2_ball_start_s: first sustained move of the ball out of the setup hold
_events.E4_backswing_top_s: top of the backswing (apex, ball highest)
_events.E5_slide_start_s: the slide foot starts its final slide
_events.E7_release_s: ball leaves the hand (bottom of the swing)
_events.E8_slide_stop_s: slide foot stops at the line
_events.E9_finish_hold_end_s: end of the posted finish (you come out of the hold)
_events.step_count: number of approach steps (integer, e.g. 4 or 5)
